title: Practical Magic 2's Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman & More with Andy Cohen
summary: Listen to the full "Practical Magic 2 Front Row" on Radio Andy and anytime on the SiriusXM app.

The stars of *Practical Magic 2* — Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Lee Pace, Joey King, Maisie Williams, and Xolo Marindueña — join[Andy Cohen](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/andy-cohen) for a special Front Row event.


[Practical Magic 2 Front Row Hosted by Andy Cohen Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogPracticalMagic2FrontRowRadioAndy)


Listen to the full *Practical Magic 2 Front Row* event on[Radio Andy (Ch. 101)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) on car radios starting Thursday, September 10 and anytime on the[SiriusXM app here](https://sxm.app.link/BlogPracticalMagic2FrontRowRadioAndy) .


In the meantime, watch a clip from the exclusive special above now.
